messages:
dina_prod: quick design drop for batch-embed import + rerank table tweaks. goal: make bulk upload -> preview -> rerank smoother. figma: https://figma.redwood/example/batch-rerank-compact mika_design: nice start. two main asks: make row selection visual but subtle, and show inline export CTA when >1 row selected. keep the vectors compact. leah_a11y: a11y checklist: ensure the table has `role="grid"`, rows have `aria-selected`, and the export CTA uses `aria-disabled` when not actionable. add sr-only summary at top: 'Vectors preview, X rows'. sam_frontend: implementation notes: use a lightweight selection bar that appears above the grid with actions: Download | Add to dataset | Rerank. keyboard: Space toggles selection, Shift+Click for range, Esc clears. mobile: long-press to select. owen_research: when reranking, can we show a small before/after relevance delta per row? simple +/- number next to the relevance chip would help triage. mika_design: good idea. delta should be color+icon coded (up/down chevron) plus text for screen readers. microcopy: 'Relevance +12%' or 'Relevance -3%'. leah_a11y: ensure delta has sr-only text like 'Relevance changed by plus twelve percent' and never conveyed by color alone. dina_prod: export behavior: immediate download for <=300 rows, otherwise queue job with notification. copy for queue: 'Your export is queued — we'll email you a link when ready.' add opt-in checkbox 'Always queue large exports'. sam_frontend: code sketch for export modal status: `
Export queued. Job #12345.
` also keep estimated size (rows x cols) in modal. mika_design: visual nit: pinned rows currently use subtle gray badge. change to toggle button with `aria-pressed` and visible focus ring. also make the kebab menu keyboard-accessible and not hover-only. aria_bot: a11y-scan: flagged items: relevance contrast borderline on light theme (3.2:1), export status missing aria-live on current branch, hover-only kebab detected. dina_prod: thanks everyone. next steps: Sam prototypes keyboard nav + queue modal, Mika updates figma with delta chips + selection bar, Leah will run quick a11y pass after changes. I'll write the ticket for export thresholds and background worker. react with :eyes: if you want to join a short review tomorrow.
